m4-original.runtime: Sikarugir Wine 10 rev6; original runtime; D3DMetal 4.0b2
m4-original.note: Original E6 baseline. Later runtime revisions are recorded separately.

m4-driver-version-1.note: Accepted runtime with text-input backport and optional Helldivers driver-version compatibility.

16030.recommendation: Use windowed mode: turn off Fullscreen in the game's Options. The accepted saved configuration is 1024×768 with FullScreen=False.
16030.summary: Playable with caveats: use windowed mode. User confirms gameplay, audio, controls and saving/resuming work. Fullscreen startup produced D3DERR_INVALIDCALL.

results.notes: Startup initially displayed D3DERR_INVALIDCALL; the capture later reached the name-entry menu. Wine logged rejected display-mode changes. With the saved profile in windowed 1024×768 mode, the next launch rendered normally without an observed error dialog or logged display-mode-change failure. User then confirmed all functional checks. Residual OpenGL diagnostics did not prevent this acceptance; no measured FPS or full-screen compatibility is claimed. Shared Metal 3 is the launcher default, not the game's rendering API; DXMT/DXVK were not tested.

15900.recommendation: No working configuration established for the current setup.
15900.summary: Unplayable: startup reports unsupported color depth or display resolution and requires at least 16-bit color and 800×600. A scoped virtual-desktop preference trial did not resolve the Steam launch.

results.version: Wine 10 legacy display path; DirectDraw and D3D8 imports
results.api: DirectDraw / Direct3D 8 imports; gameplay rendering not reached
results.notes: Normal Steam launch reproduces the minimum-display-requirements error. A fresh-prefix probe using the selected runtime reports 1800×1169 at 32-bit color but no 800×600 mode in Win32, DirectDraw or D3D8 enumeration. Virtual-desktop probes expose the missing modes, but a per-executable registry trial did not fix the real Steam launch and was reverted. An isolated explicit-desktop game attempt did not establish startup. This is not a DXMT/DXVK qualification or a proven sole root cause.

2379780.recommendation: Use the normal Windows launch with the shared runtime. No game-specific override was needed for the reported functional pass.
2379780.summary: User reports Balatro works great and confirms saving/resuming a run, audio and controls all work.

results.version: Bundled LÖVE / SDL2; framework versions not independently verified
results.api: LÖVE framework; active graphics API not traced
results.notes: User-confirmed gameplay, save/resume, audio and controls. Managed Steam lists build 17459173; the installed files include love.dll and SDL2.dll and the bundled readme identifies LÖVE. The configured shared default is Metal 3 with no per-game override, which does not establish the actual rendering API. No measured FPS, exact session duration, or DXMT/DXVK qualification is claimed.

526870.recommendation: Apple backend / shared Metal 3 default. DXMT is a functionally tested alternative with temporary stuttering. Avoid the tested DXVK payload for this game.
526870.summary: DXMT passed gameplay and save/reload. DXVK was unplayable in hands-on testing; subsequent experiments did not establish a fix.

results.notes: User confirmed the 15-minute gameplay, rendering, audio, controls and save/reload checklist at Medium, saved 1800×1169. No measured FPS. Metal 3 is the subsequently retained shared default; this baseline is not a new timed Metal 3 run.

User confirmed gameplay, audio, controls, manual test save and reload. Movement was initially choppy and settled; similar temporary stuttering was reported in the default mode. No measured performance ranking.

Rendered-menu qualification passed, but hands-on gameplay had very slow loading, severe choppiness and poor responsiveness. GPU-query timeouts occurred in some runs. Newer MoltenVK and an occlusion-culling trial did not establish a fix. Save/reload acceptance was not completed.

553850.recommendation: Metal 3 compatibility with the accepted runtime and Helldivers-specific settings.
553850.summary: The Apple path reaches the ship and has user-confirmed control. Both optional backends crash during the tested DX11 startup path.

results.api: Gameplay rendering API unresolved in the same-flag comparison
results.notes: Ship rendering and user control were accepted. The diagnostic --use-d3d11 control also reached the ship but created both D3D11 and D3D12 devices; that does not identify the rendering API. No full mission, measured FPS, or save/reload acceptance is claimed. Use the normal Apple launch; the flag is not a required workaround.

results.api: D3D11 requested; gameplay rendering not reached
results.notes: Startup crash, including a fresh shader-cache trial. Renderer logs reject requested feature level 12_0 and report maximum 11_1. The rejected request is established, not proven to be the sole crash cause.

results.api: D3D11 requested; gameplay rendering not reached
results.notes: Startup crash, including a fresh shader-cache trial. D3D11 feature-level 12_0 probing is rejected. Do not infer that the historical DX11 flag is nonexistent, or that these results cover other DXVK versions/platforms.

413150.recommendation: Use the normal Windows launch with the shared runtime. Playable with a known duplicate-cursor issue; no DX11/DX12 backend override is required for this DesktopGL build.
413150.summary: User reports the game works great and confirms saving and reloading work. Both macOS and Stardew cursors can be visible simultaneously.

results.notes: Hands-on functional acceptance: user reported gameplay works great after the gameplay/audio/control checklist, then explicitly confirmed save/reload. Known caveat: simultaneous macOS and game cursors. A hardware-cursor preference trial did not resolve it and was reverted. No measured FPS, exact session duration, independently verified resolution, or draw-call API trace is claimed. This is not a DXMT/DXVK qualification.
